rationale: RA2 is RA1's chart plus one prescription. It is a declared clone (data/patients/manifest.json, synthetic_patients; T-93, D113) carrying one appended MedicationRequest for etanercept, a drug L35677's LIMITATIONS paragraph names and Synthea's rheumatoid arthritis module never orders at any population size - the module's whole pharmacy is naproxen, methotrexate and prednisone, so this fact cannot be generated and is declared instead. The labeled claim is the pairing: the same chart that meets both criteria the system can evaluate is NOT_COVERED once the excluded drug is on it, the denial cites the prescription that fired it, and no criterion is evaluated at all - an exclusion fires before the graph, which is why it has no verdict to abstain with (REQ-60, D41's shape, D111). Note-free for RA1's reason.
